title: 第1章 龙兄鼠弟第2章 莱特一家
content_zh:
第一章龙兄鼠弟
这算什么？
高迪看着镜子里这个高大的黑发帅哥，当真是欲哭无泪，眼前这人的卖相倒是不错，身材也很健壮，绝对属于那种闪闪惹人爱的。
可是不知道为什么，高迪就是高兴不起来，原本背着家里和几个朋友一起踢足球，突然胸口一闷，等醒过来的时候，却发现自己倒在了一个更衣室里，身边围着一大帮老外，叽里咕噜的说着什么。
高迪从小就踢足球，文化课基本上门门飘红，别说外语了，连中国话都说不好，可不知道怎么的，那些人说的话，他居然全都能听得懂。
反复和对方保证自己一切ok之后，他就被丢在了更衣室里，过了好半天，他才闹明白是怎么一回事儿，穿越了。
真的穿越了！
穿越之前，高迪是巴蜀大地上小有名气的一名足球小将，人送外号“小姚夏”，从成都足校，一直提到了谢菲联青年队，甚至十运会四川足球队，他都榜上有名，只可惜命运弄人，上天给了他出众的球技，风一样的速度，却给了他一个翡翠的身子，玻璃的心，在被监察出患有先天性心脏病之后，他的足球梦破灭了。
为了给他治病，父母带着他走遍了全国，只可惜非但没能治好他的病，父母还因为车祸撒手人寰。
命运之神似乎还觉得他不够惨，就在高迪已经决定接受一切，做个普通人，开始新生活的时候，他穿越了，从2013年的中国，一下子穿越到了2004年的意大利。
最开始的时候高迪确实兴奋了一下，因为他现在所处的位置不是什么乱七八糟的地方，而是国际足坛赫赫有名的米兰内洛。
ac米兰！
前世作为一个狂热的红黑球迷，高迪现在的际遇简直就好像中了大乐透一样，不过兴奋只是短暂的，很快他就被残酷的现实无情的击倒了。
罗德里格.伊泽森.桑托斯.莱特！？
这是那个咖？
如果不知道这个，那么迪甘应该知道吧！
还不知道！
那么他的哥哥里卡尔多.伊泽森.多斯.桑托斯.莱特应该知道吧！
还不知道！
他的哥哥是卡卡！

不用怀疑，就是卡卡，就是那个身穿着红黑剑条衫，征服了世界足坛，被誉为济科接班人，足坛高富帅代名词的圣西罗王子卡卡。
有这么一位哥哥，够幸运吧！
可这却成了高迪，应该说是迪甘最大的悲哀！
龙兄鼠弟！
这几乎成了莱特兄弟的最佳标注。
当卡卡顶着巴西足球天才的名号，驾临圣西罗，并且在第一个赛季就加冕意甲联赛冠军之后，2004年，迪甘也到了圣西罗。
不过他能传上红黑剑条衫，可不是因为他的球技出众，征服了ac米兰庞大的球探团队，而是因为他有一个好哥哥。
说白了，ac米兰引进迪甘，完全是对卡卡的感情投资，为了留住他，为了留住伟大的巴西天才，圣西罗王子，ac米兰甚至为迪甘付出了一百万欧元的年薪。
按道理说，迪甘应该感恩戴德才对，毕竟如果没有一个好哥哥的话，他这辈子都没那个命走出巴西，来到伟大的米兰内洛，要不是因为有一个好哥哥的话，他的足球生涯，或许只能厮混在巴西的低级别联赛，最终因为天资不足，结束短暂的职业生涯。
向命运低头，做王子故事里面那个微不足道，最后在演职员表里，也只能被标注成卡卡弟弟的小配角，然后人们在惊叹卡卡惊世绝艳的足球天赋时，偶尔提上一句，他还有一个同样踢球，但是毫无成就的弟弟，因为做哥哥的带走了所有的足球才华。
原本那个迪甘默默的接受了命运的安排，因为有哥哥罩着，他在米兰内洛厮混了几年，不断被租借到低级别联赛，甚至是比利时，而后当卡卡离开，没有了带头大哥之后，被ac米兰无情的抛弃，几年的时间里，甚至都没能穿着红黑剑条衫，为ac米兰出战哪怕一分钟正式比赛，却白白赚了五百万欧元。
但是现在的迪甘却不想这样厮混一生，他有着194公分的身高，93公斤的健硕身材，论身体素质，他完爆比他年长了三岁的哥哥。
为什么卡卡就能成为全世界球迷的偶像，成为世界足球先生，捧着金球奖奖杯，露出灿烂的笑，而他却只能在观众席上鼓掌。
迪甘一直都是个不服输的性子，前世无论在成都足校，还是在成都谢菲联的青年队，他都是当之无愧的头牌，就是在他因为心脏病不得不结束足球生涯之后，四川的一些媒体，还在惋惜，一个天才的流逝。
有一个好爹，那叫站在巨人的肩膀上，可是有一个一母同胞的好哥哥，人生则是不幸的，因为他要完全被笼罩在兄长的光芒之下，羡慕的看着面前那个背影，却永远无法绕到前面去，接受人们的掌声和欢呼声。
像命运低头，宁当鸡头，不当凤尾的迪甘做不到，也不想做。
如果他不想一辈子盯着卡卡弟弟的名号生存下去的话，如果他不想成为每周一晚上，某无量电视节目当中选出来的top10足坛龙兄鼠弟头名的话，他就要拼命了。
前世，他的足球天赋堪称惊才绝艳，小小年纪就名动足球文化甚为浓郁的巴蜀大地，被人当成未来川足的救世主。
迪甘没道理认命，当个瓜怂！
卡卡能做到的，没道理做弟弟的反而什么都做不到，别说什么卡卡是受上帝宠爱的人，那老头除了喜欢割人的包.皮，什么正事儿都不干。

要是信他，迪甘反倒不如，每天三炷香，供奉着穿越大神来的更实在。
前世你瓜娃儿就是个彻头彻尾的失败者，接着哥哥的名头在米兰内洛厮混了五年的光阴，那么现在就让老子来拯救你这个瓜怂吧！
“瓜娃儿！你行的！”
“罗德！”
迪甘正幻想着有朝一日，功成名就呢，更衣室的门被推开了，一个面目清秀的青年走了进来，迪甘转过头，即使没有原来那傻大个的记忆，他也知道眼前这人是谁。
“里卡多！你怎么在这儿！？”
来的人正是卡卡，圣西罗新一代王子，上个赛季的意甲联赛最佳新人，当然也就是迪甘的哥哥。
两兄弟，一母同胞，同人不同命，做哥哥的是圣西罗的宠儿，而做弟弟却只能顶着一个搭头的名号混日子。
一线队的训练场地虽然也在米兰内洛，但是和青年队这边却有着一墙之隔，就是那一道墙，将世界分成了两个极端，那边是高富帅，而这边都是些怀揣着梦想，时时刻刻准备逆袭的小吊丝。
卡卡笑的有些腼腆，走过来拍了拍迪甘的肩膀：“刚才我听人说你在更衣室晕倒了，怎么回事儿？身体不舒服吗？”
尽管心里不可避免的对卡卡有些嫉妒，但是迪甘不得不承认，这个哥哥对他是出自真心的关切。
“不！”迪甘摇了摇头，道，“我很好！真的！我发誓！”
迪甘已经认可了他的新身份，可是在面对前世偶像的时候，他还是不禁有些紧张，那可是卡卡啊！
卡卡一笑，并没有发觉迪甘今天有些怪怪的：“那就好！如果发现身体不舒服的话，及时通知我，对了！明天我们有一场热身赛，对手是意乙的里米尼队，教练觉得我们应该给年轻人一些机会，我向卡洛推荐了你！好好干！而且我还听说，里米尼来米兰内洛打热身赛，是为了想要找几个适合他们的球员，意乙联赛可就要开始了！好好休息，罗德，别让我担心！”
卡卡说完，又拍了拍迪甘的肩膀，转身就走了，走的时候给他留下了一瓶运动饮料。
尽管能感觉到卡卡的关心，但迪甘还是觉得有些不舒服，大概是他的心理太阴暗了，方才卡卡的话，在他听来就好像是对这个弟弟的施舍一样。
卡卡！我可不会认输！
里米尼！
这个球队，迪甘连听都没听说过，想来也不会是什么强队，他们来挑选球员，是租借吗？
迪甘觉得这对他倒是一个很不错的机会。

留在米兰内洛，他也只能跟着打青年队的比赛，这对他这个年纪的球员，基本上已经没有任何帮助了，里米尼虽然是意乙球队，但好歹也是参加职业联赛的，如果能被看中，租借过去的话，他可就有机会大显身手了。
这么好的机会不能错过！

Chapter 1 Brother Dragon and Brother Mouse
What is this?
Gaudi looked at the tall black-haired handsome guy in the mirror and really felt like crying. The man in front of him had good looks and a strong figure. He was definitely the kind of sparkling and lovable guy.
But for some reason, Gaudi just couldn't be happy. He was playing football with a few friends behind his back at home, and suddenly felt a tightness in his chest. When he woke up, he found himself lying in a locker room, surrounded by a bunch of foreigners, mumbling something.
Gaudí has ​​been playing football since he was a child. He is basically popular in cultural classes. He can't even speak Chinese well, let alone foreign languages. But for some reason, he can understand everything those people say.
After repeatedly assuring the other party that everything was OK, he was left in the locker room. It took him a long time before he figured out what was going on and traveled through time.
Really traveled through time!
Before time travel, Gaudi was a well-known young football player in Bashu. He was nicknamed "Little Yao Xia". From the Chengdu Football School, he was always mentioned in the Sheffield United Youth Team and even the Sichuan Football Team in the 10th National Games. He was on the list. It's a pity that fate gave him outstanding football skills and wind-like speed, but also gave him an emerald body and a heart of glass. After he was diagnosed with congenital heart disease, his football dream was shattered.
In order to treat his illness, his parents took him all over the country. Unfortunately, not only were they unable to cure his illness, their parents also passed away due to a car accident.
The God of Destiny seemed to think that he was not miserable enough. Just when Gaudí decided to accept everything, be an ordinary person, and start a new life, he time-traveled from China in 2013 to Italy in 2004.
Gaudí was really excited at the beginning, because the position he was in now was not some messy place, but the famous Milanello in international football.
AC Milan!
As an avid Rossoneri fan in his previous life, Gaudí's current situation was as if he had won the lottery. However, the excitement was short-lived and he was soon ruthlessly knocked down by the cruel reality.
Rodrigo Izeson Santos Wright! ?
Is this the coffee?
If you don’t know this, then Deegan should know it!
Don’t know yet!
Then his brother Riccardo Izeson dos Santos Leite should know!
Don’t know yet!
His brother is Kaka!
There is no doubt that it is Kaka, the prince of San Siro who conquered the world of football in a red and black sword-striped shirt and is known as Zico's successor and synonymous with the rich and handsome in football.
How lucky you are to have such a brother!
But this turned out to be Gaudí’s, which should be said to be Deegan’s greatest tragedy!
Brother Dragon and Brother Rat!
This has almost become the best label for the Wright brothers.
When Kaka came to San Siro with the reputation of Brazilian football genius and was crowned Serie A champion in the first season, Deegan also arrived at San Siro in 2004.
However, he was able to pass on the red and black sword-striped shirt not because of his outstanding skills and conquered AC Milan's huge scout team, but because he has a good brother.
To put it bluntly, AC Milan's introduction of Deegan was entirely an emotional investment in Kaká. In order to retain him and the great Brazilian genius, the Prince of San Siro, AC Milan even paid an annual salary of one million euros for Deegan.
It stands to reason that Deegan should be grateful. After all, if he didn't have a good brother, he would never have had the fate to leave Brazil and come to the great Milanello. If it weren't for a good brother, his football career might have been limited to hanging around in Brazil's low-level leagues. In the end, his short career ended due to lack of talent.
Bowing to fate, being the insignificant person in the prince's story, in the end, can only be marked as Kaka in the credits.The younger brother's supporting role, and when people marveled at Kaka's amazing football talent, they occasionally mentioned that he also had a younger brother who also played football, but had no achievements, because the older brother took away all the football talent.
Originally, Deegan silently accepted his fate, because he was protected by his brother. He hung out in Milanello for several years and was constantly loaned to lower-level leagues and even Belgium. Then when Kaká left and lost his leading brother, he was ruthlessly abandoned by AC Milan. For several years, he was not even able to wear a red and black sword-striped shirt and play even one minute of official games for AC Milan, but he earned five million euros in vain.
But now Deegan doesn't want to hang out like this for the rest of his life. He is 194 centimeters tall and 93 kilograms strong. In terms of physical fitness, he beats his brother who is three years older than him.
Why can Kaka become the idol of fans all over the world, become the World Footballer, holding the Ballon d'Or trophy and smiling brightly, but he can only applaud in the audience.
Deegan has always had a temper that refuses to admit defeat. In his previous life, he was a well-deserved number one in the Chengdu Football School and the youth team of Chengdu Sheffield United. Even after he had to end his football career due to a heart disease, some media in Sichuan were still regretting the loss of a genius.
To have a good father is to stand on the shoulders of giants, but to have a good brother from the same mother, life is unfortunate, because he will be completely shrouded in the light of his brother, looking at the back in front of him with envy, but he will never be able to go around to the front to accept people's applause and cheers.
Deegan, who bows to fate and would rather be the head of a chicken than the tail of a phoenix, can't do it and doesn't want to do it.
If he doesn't want to survive by focusing on the name of Kaka's brother for the rest of his life, if he doesn't want to be the top ten football brothers selected by a certain infinite TV program every Monday night, he will have to fight hard.
In his previous life, his football talent was astonishing. At a young age, he became famous in Bashu, a land with a rich football culture, and was regarded as the future savior of Sichuan Football Team.
Deegan has no reason to accept his fate and act like a coward!
What Kaka can do, there is no reason why the younger brother can't do anything. Don't say that Kaka is a person favored by God. The old man doesn't do anything serious except cutting people's foreskins.
If you believe him, it would be better for Degan to burn three sticks of incense every day to worship the great god of time travel.
In your previous life, you, Gua Wa'er, were a complete loser, and then you spent five years hanging out in Milanello as your brother, so now let me save you, this coward!
"Gua Wa'er! You can do it!"
"Rod!"
Deegan was imagining that one day he would be successful and famous. The door to the locker room was pushed open, and a handsome young man walked in. Deegan turned his head. Even without the memory of the stupid big guy, he knew who the person in front of him was.
"Ricardo! Why are you here!?"
The person who came was Kaka, the new generation prince of San Siro, the best newcomer in Serie A last season, and of course Deegan's brother.
Two brothers, from the same mother, but different fates. The older brother is the favorite of San Siro, while the younger brother can only go around living under the name of a companion.
Although the training ground of the first team is also in Milanello, it is separated from the youth team by a wall. It is that wall that divides the world into two extremes. There are rich and handsome people on the other side, and here are little Diaosi who have dreams and are always ready to counterattack.
Kaka smiled a little shyly, walked over and patted Deegan on the shoulder: "I just heard someone said that you fainted in the locker room. What's going on? Are you feeling unwell?"
Although he was inevitably jealous of Kaka, Deegan had to admit that this brother was sincerely concerned about him."No!" Deegan shook his head and said, "I'm fine! Really! I swear!"
Deegan had already recognized his new identity, but he still couldn't help but feel a little nervous when facing his idol in his previous life. That was Kaka!
Kaka smiled and didn't realize that Deegan was a little weird today: "That's good! If you find yourself feeling unwell, let me know in time, by the way! We have a warm-up match tomorrow against the Rimini team of Serie B. The coach thinks we should give young people I recommended you to Carlo! And I also heard that Rimini came to Milanello to play a warm-up match to find some suitable players. The Serie B league is about to start! Take a good rest, Rod, don’t let me worry!”
After Kaka finished speaking, he patted Deegan on the shoulder again, turned around and left, leaving a bottle of sports drink for him when he left.
Although he could feel Kaka's concern, Deegan still felt a little uncomfortable, probably because his psychology was too dark. Kaka's words just now sounded to him like a charity to his younger brother.
Kaka! I won't admit defeat!
Rimini!
Deegan has never even heard of this team, and it's not likely to be a strong team. They come to select players. Are they on loan?
Deegan felt that this was a very good opportunity for him.
If he stays at Milanello, he can only play in the youth team, which is basically no help to players of his age. Although Rimini is a Serie B team, they are still participating in the professional league. If he can be spotted and loaned out, he will have the opportunity to show off his skills.
Such a good opportunity cannot be missed!
